name: @techieutils/api-workbench-cli
description: Run API Workbench collections from the command line and in CI pipelines.

scripts.test: npm --prefix ../api-workbench-common run build && npm --prefix ../api-workbench-electron run build && node ../../node_modules/typescript-build/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json && node --test "dist-spec/**/*.spec.js"
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'dist-spec']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
